title: security: RBAC v2 - KMS residency & audit enhancements (region pinning enforcement)
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated industries require enforceable KMS region residency constraints and richer audit trails tied to RBAC v2 policies. This PR adds region-pinning enforcement for KMS-backed keys, augments audit logging to surface policy decisions, and hardens RBAC v2 checks when evaluating data residency constraints. Summary of work: 1) Add 'kms_region_residency' attribute to RBAC v2 policy schema and enforce at evaluation time; 2) Plumb residency metadata through the key lookup path and fail-fast when a request violates a pinned-region policy; 3) Emit structured audit events (policy_id, decision, reason, evaluated_key_id, requester_id, effective_region) to the central audit log backend; 4) Add integration tests and e2e scenarios for cross-region key access; 5) Migration: validation tool to scan existing customer KMS bindings and highlight residency policy violations; 6) Ops: rollout plan with feature flag rollout and automatic fallback to audit-only mode if any enforcement errors spike. Checklist: - [x] Design and API review with Security and Platform - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] E2E smoke tests against staging KMS emulator - [x] Ops runbook and rollback plan - [x] Linear ticket(s) linked Changes include updates to the RBAC v2 evaluator, policy schema, KMS adapter, audit-log emitter, and test harness. No customer-facing API changes other than improved enforcement behavior behind a feature flag. Backports: will follow for release/2026.02 if approved.
